reason: My clients already pay me by mobile money and I send the file on WhatsApp in two minutes. With Maketia I still have to confirm each payment by hand and send the link myself, so it adds a step and a SasPay account without saving me any work.
objection: If confirmation is still manual, what am I paying 9 900 FCFA a month for? A pretty page that sends people out of WhatsApp, where they trust me, to a link they don't know.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation with instant delivery of the file, working with Orange Money / Wave directly, so sales happen while I sleep.
